items.definition:
tending to avoid commitment or direct answers
He gave an evasive answer to the question.

unsuccessful or useless
Their efforts to find a solution proved fruitless.

thoughtless; not showing concern for others' feelings
It was inconsiderate of him to play loud music late at night.

relating to interpretation; explanatory
The interpretive dance conveyed a powerful message.

having a specified manner; often used in compounds like 'well-mannered'
He was a very well-mannered young man.

corresponding in size or amount to something else
The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.

shoddy (badly made or done)
The shoddy workmanship of the furniture meant it broke quickly.

sleazy (sordid, corrupt, or immoral; disreputable)
He was known for his sleazy business practices and questionable ethics.

tireless (having or showing a lot of energy or effort; indefatigable)
The volunteers showed tireless dedication to the cause.

toothed (having teeth or tooth-like projections)
The saw had a finely toothed blade for precision cutting.

not clearly defined or explained
The terms of the agreement remained undefined.

anxious or fearful that something bad will happen
She felt apprehensive about the upcoming exam.

tending to confront or challenge
His confrontational style often led to arguments.

skillful in using underhanded tactics to achieve goals
He used devious methods to get what he wanted.

behaving in a way that shows a playful sexual attraction
She gave him a flirty smile across the room.

Not able to be cured or remedied.
The disease was incurable, but treatments could manage the symptoms.

speaking or using several languages
She grew up in a multilingual household.

having a specified nature or character
He is a very good-natured person.

Capable of being programmed.
This new device is fully programmable.

often ill; weak
The sickly child often missed school due to various ailments.

unwilling to spend money; ungenerous
He's so stingy that he never buys anyone a round of drinks.

lacking fresh air; formal and old-fashioned
The room felt stuffy after hours with all the windows closed.

reliable; dependable
He always relied on his trusty old car.

not yet verified or established
The reports of the incident remain unconfirmed.

not discovered or noticed
The thief managed to escape undetected.

not deserved or reasonable
His anger was completely unjustified.

not officially recorded or registered
The car was unregistered, making it illegal to drive.

not having been trained
The untrained staff struggled with the new software.

Coming or happening later than should have been the case.
Please accept my belated birthday wishes.

Having an outline or surface that curves inward like the interior of a circle or sphere.
A concave lens spreads out light rays.

Following as a result or effect.
The drought led to a consequent rise in food prices.

Resembling or characteristic of earth or soil; practical and realistic.
The wine had a rich, earthy flavor.

(Of a law, rule, or obligation) able to be imposed or observed.
The contract contains clauses that are legally enforceable.

filled with excessive and single-minded zeal
He was a fanatical supporter of the local football team.

serving as an example or explanation
The teacher provided an illustrative example to clarify the concept.

not clear or sharply defined
The photograph was old and the figures in it were indistinct.

done according to a systematic or established procedure
She approached the task in a very methodical way.

relating to or resembling a myth; legendary
The hero embarked on a mythic quest to save the kingdom.

relating to speech sounds
The phonetic transcription helps learners pronounce words correctly.

relating to Tuscany, Italy
They admired the beautiful Tuscan landscape.

out of control with anger or excitement; wild or frenzied
The crowd went berserk when their team scored.

serving to connect
Connective tissue provides support and binds other tissues together.

having a crisp outer layer
We enjoyed the warm, crusty bread with our soup.

not alike; different
Despite their dissimilar backgrounds, they became good friends.

dull and uninteresting
The old building had a drab, gray exterior.

without a head
The headless statue stood in the garden.

impossible to replace
Her contribution to the team was irreplaceable.

not easily upset or excited; calm and peaceful
The placid lake reflected the clear blue sky.

acting in accordance with morality and good behavior
She is a very principled person who always stands up for what is right.

Quick and energetic; stylish
He gave a snappy answer to the question.

without official permission
Access to this area is strictly unauthorised.

not having had any parts removed or hidden
The director's cut included uncensored scenes.

too bad to be forgiven
His betrayal was unforgivable.

without inhabitants; empty of people
They discovered an uninhabited island.

extremely happy; full of joy
They spent a blissful afternoon by the lake.

resembling or characteristic of jazz music; lively and stylish
She wore a jazzy dress to the party.

crazy or silly
He had some looney ideas about how to solve the problem.

traveling away from a particular place
The outbound flight was delayed.

relating to or determined by position
The chess player made a strong positional move.

aggressively ambitious or self-assertive
She found the salesperson a bit too pushy.

having a pleasant, salty or spicy taste rather than sweet
I prefer savory snacks over sweet ones.

Tender, juicy, and tasty (of food); having thick fleshy leaves (of plants).
The roast chicken was incredibly succulent and flavorful.

Showing good taste; aesthetically pleasing.
The interior design of the house was very tasteful.

Not yet found or known.
There are still many undiscovered species in the deep ocean.
